learning_outcomes.text: Learn to function in the work environment, developing competencies related to teamwork, autonomous work, decision-making, etc.
Develop the specific activities entrusted according to the nature of the company.

syllabus_topics: Activity in the field of Engineering (electrical, industrial electronics and automation, mechanical, industrial technologies) to be developed in a company.
assessment_rules: The final grade (CF) is calculated as CF = 0.70 x CM + 0.30 x CTE, where CM is the grade obtained from the internship report and CTE is the grade provided by the external tutor. The internship report should demonstrate exploitation of the practices and will be graded based on clarity, format, depth of explanations, conclusions, and adherence to orthographic and grammatical rules. The external tutor's evaluation will consider the work developed, formality, interest, and adaptability to the environment. This subject cannot be evaluated by a global test.
